scenario_title: Starting a new structured play activity
minimal_context: The student is in a small group play-based intervention session and is asked to use six bricks to build a vehicle.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to use these six bricks to build something that can move. You can start building now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stays back and watches the bricks instead of joining in, remaining quiet and withdrawn.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should build? Go ahead and pick up the bricks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Avoids eye contact and goes into a shell, not communicating.) I am freezing. I am cold.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It's not cold in here. Let's just focus on the work and try to build a vehicle.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Legs shaking, starts crying and refuses to complete the work.) I want to leave.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Today we are going to use these six bricks to build something that can move. You can start building now.

STUDENT: (Stays back and watches the bricks instead of joining in, remaining quiet and withdrawn.)

TUTOR: What do you think you should build? Go ahead and pick up the bricks.

STUDENT: (Avoids eye contact and goes into a shell, not communicating.) I am freezing. I am cold.

TUTOR: It's not cold in here. Let's just focus on the work and try to build a vehicle.

STUDENT: (Legs shaking, starts crying and refuses to complete the work.) I want to leave.

task.content: Engage in a warm-up activity using six bricks to build something that could move, or a structured constructive play using a magnetic set with a picture to build a vehicle.

context.environment: Play-based intervention group setting during the first three sessions.
context.materials: Six bricks, magnetic set with a picture, visual attendance chart with stickers, visual chart with names/dates/times, 5-point emotional scale, simple instruction cards.
context.social_setting: Small group with an adult-to-child ratio of 1:2 to 1:4.
context.time_context: Beginning of a 45 min or 60 min session.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When presented with new activities or an unfamiliar environment during the initial sessions.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Crying a lot, wanting to leave, staying back and watching instead of joining in, legs shaking, not making eye contact with anyone, refusing to complete the work.
related_quotes: I am freezing. I am cold.

behavior_patterns.condition: When feeling anxious about social or learning situations.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Goes into a shell on his own and doesn’t like to speak about things, crying, not communicating, not eating, complains of not feeling well, quiet and withdrawn.
